# Nithin Jambula

> Robotics software engineer and agentic AI systems builder, who also works on the architecture and infrastructure underneath both. Based in Amaravati, India. Open to robotics software, AI agent/LLM systems, AI architecture and ML infrastructure roles.

## Current and recent roles
- Robotics Software Intern, Ananta Technologies (Dec 2024 – present): MuJoCo/Webots simulation testing for a US client, ~40% faster build tests, two robots deployed.
- Student Researcher, AIR Centre, VIT-AP University (Jun 2024 – Nov 2025): neuro-symbolic LLM-driven API vulnerability detection (+34% vs SAST/DAST, −70% manual testing).
- Team Lead, Vulcan self-driving campus EV (Jan 2023 – present): ROS, DeepLabV3+, CARLA + SAC + DAgger, NVIDIA Jetson.
- Machine Learning Engineer, Sripto (Dec 2023 – May 2024): RAG, PDF chatbots, NL-to-SQL.

## Projects
- [16fps](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#16fps): multi-agent text-to-video (memory, tool use, reflection); commercial rights sold.
- [EchoSight](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#echosight): assistive glasses, YOLOv8 at 45+ FPS on a Raspberry Pi; patent pending; Vikas 2024 awardee.
- [WOAT](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#woat): context-aware conversational agent on Gemini.
- [DeepShield](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#deepshield): deepfake detection, published at iSAI 2025.
- [NeuroSecAPI](https://nithin434.github.io/public/projects.html#neurosecapi): neuro-symbolic API security.
